title: Workbook extract (v1)
description: Part of an .xlsx workbook, picked along two axes (which sheets, which kinds of reading) and carried as data. A PROFILE OVER data-view: every item is a data-view item, so an extract renders in pages/data-view.html unchanged, and this schema adds only what that envelope has no slot for, namely where the extract came from and what was left behind. Written by lib/kits/xlsx-extract.js. Documentation: docs/envelopes/workbook-extract.md.

source.description: Where the workbook was read from. Null when it has no address: a file dropped onto a page has bytes and a name and nothing else, and saying so is better than minting a repo path it never had.

repo.description: owner/repo, when the workbook is committed somewhere.

ref.description: A commit SHA, or a branch name where that is all the reader had. A SHA is the only form that still resolves to these bytes later.

name.description: The filename, which a dropped file has even when nothing else is known.

taken.description: When the extract was made. Ref plus time is what lets a reader tell a stale extract from a current one.

left.description: The complement of `picked` against the workbook's sheets and this format's kinds. Stated rather than inferred, because the reader of an extract cannot otherwise tell four kinds out of twelve from the whole file.

sheets.description: Sheet display names, in workbook order.

kindId.description: The kind axis. The first eight are read per sheet; the last four are read once per workbook and carry a null `sheet`.

item.description: A data-view item, plus this format's per-item record. The first five properties are data-view's and are all a data-view reader reads; the rest it ignores.

name.description: Unique within the envelope: a name is how #item= addresses one item, so a collision is a link that opens the wrong thing.

view.description: A viewer module id. `table` for every tabular kind, `code` for Power Query's M source. A preference, not a demand: the viewer falls back when the mode is unavailable.

note.description: One line, DERIVED from this item's own record rather than written beside it: the cut first ("2 of 4 rows"), then whatever the kind had to say. It exists so today's data-view reader shows the cut without knowing this format.

content.description: The item's bytes. A JSON array of row objects for a tabular kind, the M source for a query.

src.description: data-view's by-reference alternative to `content`. An extract is produced inline, so this is not written today; it is listed because an item here is a data-view item and a later writer may use it.

sheet.description: The sheet this item was read from, by display name. Null for a workbook-scoped kind.

rows.description: Rows in `content`. Null for a non-tabular kind.

total.description: Rows the workbook holds for this cell of the matrix. Equal to `rows` when nothing was cut.

truncated.description: Whether `content` is short of `total`. Reported rather than silently applied, which is pivotRecords' habit and the reason this format keeps it.
